The [[Delvin Constructs/Legends|Delvin Constructs]] Model '''MilBar F-221''' was an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] version of a
troop barracks facility designed to be constructed and deconstructed quickly at bases. With more room and privacy than the [[Model MilBar C-427]] model used by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] could provide, it featured more comfort and protection for the military personnel, though it contained fewer soldiers than the Imperial model.
